capabilities: Control where new tabs open and which tab activates on close
Navigate tabs with a keyboard-driven navigator, search, and jump hotkeys
Color-code parent-child tab relationships with selectable palettes
Prevent duplicate tabs and restore recently closed or auto-archived tabs
Toggle focus lock, focus mode, and zen mode for distraction-free editing
extras: Manifest carries a note that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Ships with English and Chinese UI. README states history stores only file paths and all patches unregister cleanly on plugin unload; a design doc (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md) is referenced.
intentEvidence: Tab Settings Enhanced is an Obsidian tab-management enhancement plugin.
problem: Obsidian offers little control over tab placement, close behavior, and no built-in keyboard navigator, visual hierarchy, or archive for tabs.

relations.evidence: does not conflict with Quick Switcher++ and similar plugins

summary: Tab management plugin that controls where new tabs open and which tab activates on close, with a keyboard-driven tab navigator and parent-child tab colors.
